sentences.text: The scientific name Micropachycephalosaurus holds the record for the longest dinosaur genus name, containing twenty-three letters.
This small creature likely reached a maximum length of just one meter.
The holotype specimen, which is the specific fossil the species is based on, was found on a cliff southwest of Laiyang in Shandong Province, China.
Dong Zhiming named and described this dinosaur in 1978.
A 2011 cladistic analysis classified Micropachycephalosaurus as a basal member of the Ceratopsia.
It inhabited China during the Campanian stage of that epoch.
Conversely, the Paleobiology Database records a wider time range from the Coniacian to Santonian stages, between 89.8 and 83.6 million years ago.
The environment was fluvial to lacustrine.
A 2024 phylogenetic analysis recovered Micropachycephalosaurus as a basal pachycephalosaur, contradicting earlier classifications.
